text:
Type: star-patterned kids rug
Use: a soft play spot on the floor; children's room, nursery, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: short soft cut pile, bound edge
Colors: pale grey, mid grey stars and side bands
Shape: rectangle with scattered five-point stars, wide darker bands down both long sides, flat and soft, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: gentle, calm, dreamy, soft
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pastel or grey textiles; Scandinavian nurseries and kids' bedrooms

product.name: HIMMELSK
product.description: The rugs thick piles dampens sound, creating a snug feeling, and are soft to walk on for all sizes of feet.
